guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the largest anomalies (latency-50 z=+403, latency-90 z=+156) and a memory jump from 4.49e7 to 2.02e8 (+349%, z=+69.8), while frontend, checkout and recommendation latencies rise downstream of it. The worst traces all run frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice at about 4.5 s with errors only in frontendservice, and the logs have no warning or error lines to contradict or add to this.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to release memory, then inspect for a memory leak or raise its memory limit. Watch currencyservice_mem and latency after the change.
